request: how many ways can you shuffle 4 cards?

beats.intent: Four cards as rectangles labelled A, B, C, D in a row
beats.narration: Four cards in a row: A, B, C, D.
beats.code:
stage.title("Shuffling 4 cards")
cards = VGroup(*[VGroup(Rectangle(width=0.9, height=1.3, color=WHITE, fill_color=BLUE_E, fill_opacity=1), Text(t, font_size=32)) for t in "ABCD"]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.3)
stage.play(FadeIn(cards))
stage.add(cards)

beats.intent: The first and last cards swapping places, then the middle two
beats.narration: Swap cards and you get a new order: D, C, B, A is one of them.
beats.code:
stage.play(Swap(cards[0], cards[3]), run_time=1)
stage.play(Swap(cards[1], cards[2]), run_time=1)

beats.intent: The row beside 4 × 3 × 2 × 1 = 24 orders
beats.narration: Four choices for the first place, three for the second, two, then one: twenty four orders.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"4 \times 3 \times 2 \times 1 = 24")

request: how many 4-digit PIN codes are there?

beats.intent: Four boxes in a row, each with the digits 0 to 9 stacked below it
beats.narration: A PIN has four places, and each can be any digit from zero to nine.
beats.code:
stage.title("How many PINs?")
boxes = VGroup(*[Square(side_length=1, color=YELLOW) for _ in range(4)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.4).shift(UP * 1.2)
stage.play(Create(boxes))
stage.add(boxes)
for b in boxes:
    digits = VGroup(*[Text(str(d), font_size=16, color=GREY_B) for d in range(10)]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.03).next_to(b, DOWN, buff=0.15)
    stage.play(FadeIn(digits), run_time=0.3)
    stage.add(digits)

beats.intent: One PIN, 4 0 7 2, written in the boxes
beats.narration: Pick one digit for each place: four, zero, seven, two.
beats.code:
for b, d in zip(boxes, "4072"):
    stage.play(FadeIn(Text(d, font_size=40).move_to(b)), run_time=0.3)

beats.intent: The boxes beside 10 × 10 × 10 × 10 = 10,000
beats.narration: Ten choices, four times over: ten thousand PINs.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"10 \times 10 \times 10 \times 10 = 10\,000")

request: what are the chances on a spinner with four colours of different sizes?

beats.intent: A spinner split into red 1/2, blue 1/4, green 1/8, yellow 1/8 with a pointer
beats.narration: A spinner: half red, a quarter blue, an eighth green and an eighth yellow.
beats.code:
stage.title("A spinner")
fr = [(0.5, RED), (0.25, BLUE), (0.125, GREEN), (0.125, YELLOW)]
start, secs = 0, VGroup()
for f, c in fr:
    secs.add(Sector(radius=2, angle=TAU * f, start_angle=start, color=c, fill_opacity=0.8))
    start += TAU * f
arrow = Arrow(ORIGIN, UP * 1.8, buff=0, color=WHITE, stroke_width=8)
stage.play(FadeIn(secs), GrowArrow(arrow))
stage.add(secs, arrow)

beats.intent: The pointer spinning round and stopping in the red half
beats.narration: Spin it. Where it stops depends only on the size of each colour's slice.
beats.code: stage.play(Rotate(arrow, 3 * TAU + PI / 2, about_point=ORIGIN), run_time=2.5)

beats.intent: Bars of the four chances 0.5, 0.25, 0.125, 0.125
beats.narration: The chances are the slice sizes: a half, a quarter, an eighth and an eighth.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
bars = draw_bars(stage, [0.5, 0.25, 0.125, 0.125], labels=["red", "blue", "green", "yellow"])

request: how long is each part of a traffic light cycle?

beats.intent: A traffic light: three circles in a dark box with the red one lit
beats.narration: A traffic light cycles through red, green and amber.
beats.code:
stage.title("A traffic light")
box = RoundedRectangle(width=1.2, height=3.2, corner_radius=0.2, color=GREY, fill_opacity=0.5).shift(LEFT * 4)
lamps = VGroup(*[Circle(radius=0.4, color=c, fill_opacity=0.15) for c in (RED, YELLOW, GREEN)]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.15).move_to(box)
stage.play(FadeIn(box), FadeIn(lamps))
stage.add(box, lamps)
stage.play(lamps[0].animate.set_fill(RED, 1))

beats.intent: A timeline bar split into red 40 s, green 30 s, amber 5 s
beats.narration: Red lasts forty seconds, green thirty, amber five.
beats.code:
parts = [(40, RED), (30, GREEN), (5, YELLOW)]
bar, x = VGroup(), -2.5
for t, c in parts:
    r = Rectangle(width=t * 0.09, height=0.6, color=c, fill_opacity=0.8).move_to(np.array([x + t * 0.045, 0, 0]))
    bar.add(r)
    x += t * 0.09
stage.play(LaggedStart(*[FadeIn(r) for r in bar], lag_ratio=0.3))
stage.add(bar)
for r, (t, _) in zip(bar, parts):
    stage.label(r, f"{t} s", direction=DOWN)

beats.intent: The timeline beside the share of time on green: 30/75 = 40%
beats.narration: A full cycle is seventy five seconds, so the light is green forty percent of the time.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"\frac{30}{75} = 40\%")

beats.intent: Thirty dots, one per vote, sorted into three coloured groups
beats.narration: Thirty students vote for a class trip: the zoo, the museum or the beach.
beats.code:
stage.title("Counting votes")
votes = [RED] * 12 + [BLUE] * 8 + [GREEN] * 10
dots = VGroup(*[Dot(radius=0.12, color=c) for c in votes]).arrange_in_grid(3, 10, buff=0.25)
stage.play(FadeIn(dots))
stage.add(dots)

beats.intent: Bars of the three totals: zoo 12, museum 8, beach 10
beats.narration: Count each colour: twelve for the zoo, eight for the museum, ten for the beach.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
bars = draw_bars(stage, [12, 8, 10], labels=["zoo", "museum", "beach"])
highlight(stage, bars[0], color=RED)

beats.intent: The winning bar beside 12/30 = 40%
beats.narration: The zoo wins with twelve of thirty: forty percent, not a majority, but the most votes.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"\frac{12}{30} = 40\%")

request: who wins if one walker starts earlier and the other walks faster?

beats.intent: Axes of time against distance with Amy's line starting at 2 km and rising slowly
beats.narration: Amy starts two kilometres ahead and walks at four kilometres an hour.
beats.code:
stage.title("Who wins the race?")
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(0, 2), y_range=(0, 12), labels=("h", "km"))
amy = plot_graph(stage, ax, lambda t: 2 + 4 * t, color=BLUE, label="Amy")

beats.intent: Ben's steeper line starting at 0 and crossing Amy's
beats.narration: Ben starts at zero but walks at six kilometres an hour, so his line is steeper.
beats.code: ben = plot_graph(stage, ax, lambda t: 6 * t, color=RED, label="Ben")

beats.intent: The crossing at 1 hour, 6 km marked beside 2 + 4t = 6t
beats.narration: They meet where the lines cross: after one hour, six kilometres along. After that Ben is ahead.
beats.code:
m = mark_point(stage, ax, 1, 6, color=YELLOW, label="1 h, 6 km")
stage.equation(r"2 + 4t = 6t \Rightarrow t = 1")

request: how many ways can you make 50p with 10p and 20p coins?

beats.intent: Five 10p coins in a row adding to 50p
beats.narration: Five ten pence coins make fifty pence.
beats.code:
stage.title("Making 50p")
coin = lambda v, c: VGroup(Circle(radius=0.35, color=c, fill_opacity=0.7), Text(f"{v}p", font_size=20))
row1 = VGroup(*[coin(10, GREY_B) for _ in range(5)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1).shift(UP * 1.6)
stage.play(FadeIn(row1))
stage.add(row1)

beats.intent: A row of one 20p and three 10p, and a row of two 20p and one 10p
beats.narration: Swap two tens for a twenty: one twenty and three tens. Swap again: two twenties and a ten.
beats.code:
row2 = VGroup(coin(20, YELLOW), *[coin(10, GREY_B) for _ in range(3)]).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1)
row3 = VGroup(coin(20, YELLOW), coin(20, YELLOW), coin(10, GREY_B)).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.1).shift(DOWN * 1.6)
stage.play(FadeIn(row2))
stage.play(FadeIn(row3))
stage.add(row2, row3)

beats.intent: The three rows numbered 1, 2, 3: three ways
beats.narration: There is no room for a third twenty, so there are exactly three ways.

request: how tall is a plant that grows 3 cm every week?

beats.intent: Bars of the plant's height over 6 weeks starting at 2 cm: 2, 5, 8, 11, 14, 17
beats.narration: A seedling two centimetres tall grows three centimetres a week.
beats.code:
stage.title("A growing plant")
h = [2 + 3 * w for w in range(6)]
bars = draw_bars(stage, h, labels=[f"wk {w}" for w in range(6)], color=GREEN)

beats.intent: Fresh axes with the heights as points and the line h = 2 + 3w through them
beats.narration: Plot the heights against weeks and they line up: height is two plus three times the week.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(0, 8), y_range=(0, 26), labels=("week", "cm"))
pts = plot_points(stage, ax, [(w, 2 + 3 * w) for w in range(6)], color=GREEN)
line = plot_graph(stage, ax, lambda w: 2 + 3 * w, color=YELLOW, label="h = 2 + 3w")

beats.intent: Week 8 marked on the extended line at 26 cm
beats.narration: Follow the line on: by week eight it will be twenty six centimetres.
beats.code: m = mark_point(stage, ax, 8, 26, color=RED, label="26 cm")

request: how do temperatures below zero work on a thermometer?

beats.intent: A vertical thermometer bar from -10 to 20 degrees filled to 5
beats.narration: A thermometer reads five degrees.
beats.code:
stage.title("Below zero")
ax = draw_axes(stage, x_range=(0, 1), y_range=(-10, 20), labels=("", "°C"), where="left")
tube = Rectangle(width=0.5, height=ax.c2p(0, 20)[1] - ax.c2p(0, -10)[1], color=WHITE).move_to(ax.c2p(0.5, 5))
fill = Rectangle(width=0.4, height=ax.c2p(0, 5)[1] - ax.c2p(0, -10)[1], color=RED, fill_opacity=0.9).align_to(tube, DOWN).set_x(tube.get_x())
stage.play(Create(tube), FadeIn(fill))
stage.add(tube, fill)

beats.intent: The red column dropping to -7 degrees, past the zero line
beats.narration: Overnight it drops twelve degrees, past zero, to minus seven.
beats.code:
zero = DashedLine(ax.c2p(0, 0), ax.c2p(1, 0), color=BLUE)
stage.play(Create(zero))
stage.add(zero)
low = Rectangle(width=0.4, height=ax.c2p(0, -7)[1] - ax.c2p(0, -10)[1], color=BLUE, fill_opacity=0.9).align_to(tube, DOWN).set_x(tube.get_x())
stage.play(Transform(fill, low), run_time=1.5)

beats.intent: The thermometer beside 5 - 12 = -7
beats.narration: Five minus twelve is minus seven: seven degrees below freezing.
beats.code: stage.equation(r"5 - 12 = -7")
